verdict.rationale: Capacities docs state that AI features are fully opt-in and no space data is shared with third-party AI services unless activated, which gives users control over AI-related data sharing, but there is no evidence of a general telemetry/usage-analytics opt-out setting for the app itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a general telemetry/analytics opt-out toggle, independent confirmation that the app collects no usage data when opted out.
